{{Current events|year=2023|month=02|day=28|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**An [[Israeli Americans|Israeli-American]] man is killed in a [[drive-by shooting]] on a highway in [[Jericho]], in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/28/israeli-american-killed-in-jericho-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**The [[Taliban]] kill the leader of operations and intelligence of [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province]] during a raid in  [[Kabul]]. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2403690/iskp-chief-killed-in-kabul (''The Express Tribune'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
***Grocery [[inflation]] in the [[United Kingdom]] reaches a record high of 17.1%, according to [[market research]] group [[Kantar Worldpanel]], amid high levels of inflation, [[supply chain]] issues and high energy costs impacting [[Economy of the United Kingdom|the economy]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/cost-of-living-grocery-inflation-hits-new-record-high-of-17-1-data-shows-12821622 (Sky News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tempi train crash]]
**A [[passenger train]] and a [[freight train]] [[train wreck|collide]] in [[Tempi (municipality)|Tempi]], [[Larissa (regional unit)|Larissa]], [[Thessaly]], [[Greece]], killing over 50 people and injuring more than 80 others. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2023/02/2-trains-collide-in-northern-greece-killing-at-least-6/ (BNO News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[Finland]] begins construction of [[Finland–Russia border barrier|a border barrier]] on its [[Finland–Russia border|border with]] [[Russia]] due to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64802457 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Nigerian presidential election]]
**Opposition parties call for a rerun of this year's presidential election after the [[Independent National Electoral Commission]] projected [[Bola Tinubu]] of the incumbent [[All Progressives Congress]] to be the next [[President of Nigeria|president]], claiming voting irregularities and [[electoral violence]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64805024 (BBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/2023/02/28/1160062514/nigeria-election-opposition-parties-call-sham (NPR)]
*[[2023 Chicago mayoral election]]
**[[Lori Lightfoot]] loses her re-election bid as [[Mayor of Chicago]], becoming the first one-term [[mayor]] in 40 years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64806760 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]]
**[[Canada]] [[Censorship in Canada|bans]] [[social media]] platform [[TikTok]] from all [[Government of Canada|government]]-issued devices, citing "an unacceptable level of risk to privacy and security" from the [[China|Chinese]]-owned app. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-64792894 (BBC News)]
